arm_coverage_thresholds.opened_definition: both wrists >=0.45m from torso midline segment and no lower than 0.15m below their shoulder (low-radar vertical)
arm_coverage_thresholds.arm_assignment: skip proximal 0.12m of upper arm; arm distance must be less than torso distance
arm_coverage_thresholds.bad_frame_rule: any opened person has zero points on both arms in the raw single frame
